capabilities: Mirror selected Supernote Cloud folders into the vault
Read .note notebooks in a built-in pager with thumbnails and page links
Export pages as Markdown, PDF, PNG, or transcribed Markdown
Transcribe handwriting via on-device recognition or AI engines
Send files to Supernote Cloud or keep a two-way Paired folder
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is more than a sync tool: it also renders .note notebooks, embeds and links pages, exports to Markdown/PDF/PNG, and transcribes handwriting.
extras: Claude Code, Codex CLI, and custom command engines are described as experimental on Windows. The plugin conflicts with Supernote (Unofficial) over the .note extension, so only one can be enabled. A Supernote Cloud account is required for all cloud features; API keys are stored in plain text in data.json, while the Cloud session token is kept in device-local storage. Licensed GPL-3.0-or-later.
problem: Obsidian cannot read Supernote .note files or reach Supernote Cloud, so handwritten notebook pages stay locked on the device and unlinked from vault notes.

relations.evidence: Sign in directly to Supernote Cloud, including verification-code login.
It depends on supernote-typescript, which is also published under GPL-3.0-or-later

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible API key for AI transcription
Claude Code or Codex CLI for desktop transcription and automations

summary: Syncs Supernote Cloud files into the vault and renders .note notebooks, with page links, exports, AI transcription, and optional two-way sync.
